availableGames.name: Campfire Quips
availableGames.blurb: Head-to-head comedy: two players, one prompt, everyone else votes.

availableGames.name: Fish Tales
availableGames.blurb: Bluffing trivia — invent a fake answer, then spot the real one hidden among everyone's lies.

availableGames.name: Lakeside Quiz
availableGames.blurb: Fast trivia in category rounds — last place picks the next category.

availableGames.name: Closest Cast
availableGames.blurb: Guess the number. Nearest wins — exact hits earn a bonus.

availableGames.name: Campfire Consensus
availableGames.blurb: Answer what you think everyone else will. Matching the herd pays.

availableGames.name: Cabin Superlatives
availableGames.blurb: Vote which friend fits the prompt. Score by agreeing with the crowd.

availableGames.name: Odd Duck Out
availableGames.blurb: Everyone knows the secret word — except the imposter. Give clues, find the faker.

availableGames.name: Porch Confessions
availableGames.blurb: A new confession every round — your phone secretly tells you to tell the truth or lie. Who's making it up?

availableGames.name: Message in a Bottle
availableGames.blurb: Write, draw, describe, repeat. Watch your phrase get hilariously mangled.

availableGames.name: Cottage Olympics
availableGames.blurb: Eleven quick real-time phone challenges — tap, react, count, roast, swat, paddle, stack. Best with Teams on!

availableGames.name: Loon Call
availableGames.blurb: A rhythm game for the whole room: listen to the loon, then echo the call on your phone — together.

availableGames.name: Lantern Lake
availableGames.blurb: Tilt your phone to glide a lantern-boat at dusk: fireflies, moonbeams, tag, a shrinking lily pad, ducklings — and one raft steered together.

availableGames.name: Storm Watch
availableGames.blurb: A storm is coming and some guests are raccoons in disguise. Pick crews, vote, sabotage — 10–15 min strategy.

availableGames.name: Cottage Crush
availableGames.blurb: A singles weekend at the lake: slip notes, reply, pick a date. Secret agendas change everything.

availableGames.name: Rainy Day Cards
availableGames.blurb: Fill in the blank. Whoever the Card Czar picks wins the round.
